inherits.meaning: all v8 constraints and the v9 post-SAT full-shell scan are retained; v10 adds a bounded static full-shell power-cycle family before the first nonlinear solver check

scope.normalization_status: explicit exact-n15 finite slice; not a universal-target consequence

power_pattern_static_centers_three_rich_.antecedent: one unconditional positive-radius rich full shell at each of the three distinct apex centers and two active positive-radius critical full rows at two distinct non-apex centers; the five columns are the five circle centers; diagonal power entries are nonzero because every radius is positive
excluded_sources: packet_B2 as an independent shell source

static_specialization.edge: i -> j iff support(shell_i, center(shell_j)) is false, hence the cross power entry is certified nonzero
static_specialization.equivalence: a nonidentity possible determinant permutation exists iff this five-vertex digraph has a directed simple cycle of length 2 through 5
static_specialization.assertion: under the two critical-row activation literals, at least one of all 84 directed simple cycles has every edge certified nonzero
static_specialization.selection: one rich radius choice at each apex times every unordered pair of non-apex critical centers
static_specialization.construction_budget_terminal: error before solver.check if either the 528-candidate or 44352-cycle-term audited bound is exceeded
static_specialization.broader_family_excluded: all five-shell-type selections are not emitted: DDD would require 6930 candidates and 582120 explicit cycle terms

artifacts.static: static_power_constraints.json records theorem, exact antecedent, counts, centers, shell names, and activation centers
artifacts.lazy: power_cuts.json retains the v9 post-SAT exact-120-permutation certificates
artifacts.formula: encoding.smt2.gz and encoding_sha256 describe the final formula, including static and any later lazy cuts

worker_provenance_gate.timing: each worker recomputes and validates provenance immediately before constructing Encoding
worker_provenance_gate.comparison: the recomputed full provenance map must exactly equal the parent-frozen map
worker_provenance_gate.failure_status: error; no Encoding is constructed and no solver check occurs

important_distinctions.full_class_only: absence from a chosen four-subset is never used as nonzero power
important_distinctions.distinct_centers: the rich product chooses at most one radius per apex; the two critical centers are distinct non-apices
important_distinctions.critical_activation: a critical row is used only under used(center)
important_distinctions.rich_activation: each selected rich class is an unconditional full ambient positive-radius class
important_distinctions.unknown_incidence: not selected is never interpreted as nonincidence
important_distinctions.solver_unsat: external evidence for this finite abstraction, not by itself a Lean closure theorem
